scientific_integrity: Finite exact simplicial computations with reproducible, self-contained certificates; prior shellability and non-vertex-decomposability are credited. The self-review do not constitute independent review.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the 16-vertex graph C16(1,4,8); no claim of generalization to other circulants or of absolute publication priority. Distinct papers and differently indexed work may contain an equivalent computation.
title: The integral top cycle and spherical vertex deletions of a shellable non-vertex-decomposable circulant
